name: build-ultra
description: AI coding assistant — Ultra AI by Build Ultra

enumDescriptions: Ultra AI runs in the cloud (hosted).
Ultra AI uses compute you configure under Build Ultra settings (advanced).
buildUltra.mode.markdownDescription: Where Ultra AI runs its language-model requests. Stored values stay `Cloud` and `Workstation` for compatibility.
buildUltra.mode.description: Where Ultra AI runs its language-model requests (Cloud vs user-configured compute).

buildUltra.computeHost.description: Host only (no http(s)://, no path); port 8080 assumed. If empty, Workstation mode uses the host from your signed-in account (Supabase user_private_compute) when set via “Link Workstation Host to Account”.

buildUltra.localIp.description: Legacy. Prefer `buildUltra.computeHost`; this setting is read only if compute host is empty.

buildUltra.localModelName.description: Default model id when the chat sends a generic model selection (when using user-configured compute).

buildUltra.localApiKey.description: Optional fallback API key for user-configured compute. Prefer Command Palette: Build Ultra: Set Private Compute API Key (Secret Storage).

commands.title: Build Ultra: Set Private Compute API Key
Build Ultra: Link Workstation Host to Account

scripts.vscode:prepublish: npm run compile && npm run build:webview
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run build:webview
